- Stack up to 4 codes

exhibits.quote: (4) in our sole discretion and without limitation, notice, or liability, to remove from the Site or otherwise disable all files and content that are excessive in size or are in any way burdensome to our systems
exhibits.argument: Vendor can remove burdensome content, limiting unlimited surveys and questions.

exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Tinder-style surveys are limited to yes/no style, not full choice.

exhibits.quote: makes it very easy for your users to complete a survey with its tinder style swipes.

exhibits.quote: Its standout feature is the swipe-style survey experience: respondents move through questions one at a time, a bit like using a dating app.
